AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
March 23, 2022
07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.
You may provide Public Comment by attending in person or emailing publiccomment@azusaca.gov by 6:00 PM on Wednesday, March 23, 2022.

Case No.: DR-2021-07 (Residential), DR-2021-08 (Park), TTM 083344 Project: The Azusa Great Park and Residential Project
Location: 807 E. Promenade
Applicant: Bill Holman for Rosedale Land Partners
The project consists of a Design Review to construct 23 residential units on 6.58 acres, a new community park on 9.1 acres and TTM to subdivide 23 individual lots and 8 lettered lots for setbacks and walkways.
The City of Azusa has prepared an Environmental Impact Report (EIR) Addendum for the project in accordance with guidelines implementing the California Environmental Quality Act (Government Code Section 15164(a) et seq.).
